tweet_summary: Crypto influencer headline: 'China is dumping U.S. treasuries and instead buying gold on a massive scale.' Paired with Trump-Xi handshake image and gold-nugget photo.
why_note_decision: Mainstream reporting (Global Times, IDN Financials, Blockonomi, Economy.ac) explicitly describes China's November 2025 Treasury position at $682.6B as 'lowest since 2008' alongside record gold accumulation — i.e. the 'dumping treasuries / buying gold' framing tracks credible reporting. The original note tries to reframe this as a 'gradual decline rather than massive dumping' citing TIC data and gold.org, but that framing is a counter-narrative, not a clear factual correction. NotHelpfulNoteNotNeeded=9 (dominant). The bot should not 'correct' a tweet that accurately summarizes major outlets.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note. Tweet's core claim aligns with mainstream reporting on China's Treasury reduction and 15-month gold-buying streak. Any note that tries to soften 'dumping' into 'gradual decline' is injecting a contested framing rather than correcting a fact, and is the canonical false positive here. If a note IS written, it must NOT understate the documented Treasury drop (lowest since 2008) or the record gold accumulation.

original_unhelpful_note.text: China's US Treasury holdings fell $6.1 billion to $682.6 billion in November 2025, continuing a gradual decline rather than massive dumping. Central bank gold purchases have been steady at about 1 tonne per month.
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: Reframes accurate reporting (lowest Treasury holdings since 2008, record gold-buying streak) as a 'gradual decline rather than massive dumping' — a contested counter-narrative, not a fact correction. Community rated NoteNotNeeded.

fact_check.claim_verdict: accurately summarizes mainstream reporting on China's treasury reduction and gold accumulation
fact_check.notes: Nov 2025 Treasuries $682.6B (lowest since Sept 2008); China's holdings down >10% since start of 2025; gold reserves at 2,308 tonnes (~$370B) after 15 straight months of purchases.

importance.lens_rationale: 2.6M impressions; macro/finance narratives matter for understanding US-China decoupling — but here the tweet's framing is supported by mainstream sources.
